answers.core: Would a GD-Extension count as core? If not, I think this might be a core feature since this is baked into the rendering process when you import meshes into the scene.
answers.workaround: There's is a reason why I suggest this feature being part of Godot 6 or later. This feat is very large in scope unless you have the manpower and donation funds to get it to work.
